name: Bronze Age steppe peoples
summary: Herders of the Eurasian steppe such as the Yamnaya, Afanasievo, Catacomb, Andronovo and Karasuk cultures, who used wagons and later chariots. Many scholars link them to the spread of Indo-European languages.

knownFor.label: Spoked-wheel chariot
knownFor.note: Light chariots found in Sintashta graves, among the earliest.

knownFor.label: Kurgan burials
knownFor.note: Burial mounds over graves of important people.

knownFor.label: Horse riding
knownFor.note: Horses became central to steppe life.
